decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal, because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable and would not harm the appearance of the site or surrounding area, and would not be harmful to the living conditions of neighbours.  Overall the development is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the buildings are occupied).
Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No.347 Wellington Road South.
description: Erection of single storey side and rear extension to house.
